plugins.name: msg-powerbi-standards
plugins.description: Built by msg: a complete, self-sufficient Power BI toolkit for Microsoft's skills-for-fabric — semantic model authoring, report planning/design/authoring/management, Fabric publishing, msg's governance rules, and msg's corporate design standards (colors, fonts, theme, layout policy), with a blank template for organizations that want their own brand instead of msg's.
